SYNTHETIC TEST DOCUMENT - FICTIONAL CLINICAL TRIAL

Clinical Study Report Synopsis
Sponsor: Halcyon Biopharma
Study: HAL-ONC-302, a Phase 3, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled study of Tremivex (lurtanib) in adults with previously treated advanced non-small cell lung cancer
Date of Report: May 9, 2026

A total of 648 patients were randomized 2:1 to lurtanib 150 mg once daily plus standard of care or placebo plus standard of care. The study met its primary endpoint: median progression-free survival was 7.4 months with lurtanib versus 4.1 months with placebo (HR 0.61; 95% CI 0.50-0.74; p<0.001). Overall survival data are immature. Grade 3 or higher treatment-emergent adverse events occurred in 52% of lurtanib patients versus 31% of placebo patients. Interstitial lung disease (ILD) was reported in 4.2% of lurtanib-treated patients, including two fatal cases. QTc prolongation >500 ms occurred in 1.8%. The sponsor plans to submit a New Drug Application in Q4 2026 and will include a risk management plan addressing ILD monitoring.

key_requirements: Submit New Drug Application in Q4 2026
Include risk management plan for interstitial lung disease monitoring
safety_signals: Interstitial lung disease in 4.2% including 2 fatal cases
output.summary: Phase 3 HAL-ONC-302 met its PFS endpoint for lurtanib in previously treated NSCLC (7.4 vs 4.1 months) with notable ILD and QTc safety signals; NDA planned for Q4 2026.
